properties.name: A fact whose subject is a RETIRED dependency goes on reading as though it describes this project — it misled an agent and then the owner, in one session, about the KvBackend seam
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-08-28. Nothing is wrong with the record; the hazard is where it points.

WHAT HAPPENED. An agent read `fact:the-storage-seam-is-published-in-design-and-private-in-code` (2026-08-21) and reported to Anthony that reflow2's design designates `ifc:kv-backend` published while the code makes it `pub(crate)` — a live design-versus-code defect in THIS repo. It is not. That fact was measured by reading /home/ajs7/project/dynograph-foundation, and its `subject_id` is `dep:dynograph-foundation`. It describes THAT project's design graph.

REFLOW2'S OWN NODE IS CORRECT, and was the whole time: `ifc:kv-backend` carries `designation: internal` and an `endpoint` reading "crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/store/backend.rs — `pub(crate) trait KvBackend: Send + Sync`". Design and code agree. Only three Interfaces here are designated `published`: ifc:graph-export, ifc:mcp-tools, ifc:mcp-tools-http.

THE SECOND HALF, AND IT IS THE PART THAT ACTUALLY WENT STALE. That fact concludes: "Swappable from INSIDE dynograph-foundation, not from outside it. A new backend — object storage, a networked KV, something sharded — is a change to that repo, not something reflow2 or flo2 could supply." TRUE WHEN WRITTEN AND FALSE THREE DAYS LATER: `dec:absorb-the-foundation-subset-and-end-the-dependency` completed 2026-08-24 and a new backend is now a change to reflow2's OWN repo. Verified 2026-08-28: no active `dynograph` dependency line in any Cargo.toml (every mention is a comment recording what was removed), `cargo tree -p reflow2-mcp` returns zero matches, and the trait is in-tree at crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/store/backend.rs.

⭐ THE GENERAL SHAPE, which is why this is recorded rather than just corrected. A fact carries a `subject_id` naming a dependency. The dependency is later RETIRED and its code ABSORBED. The fact keeps its wording, keeps reading as current, and now describes ground this project owns — while its conclusions were reasoned about a boundary that no longer exists. `loop_status` cannot see it: a TemporalFact is not a debt class. `unclaimed_findings` scoped to the absorption's ChangeEvents is the mechanism that WOULD reach it, and whether it was run at absorption time is not established here.

⚠️ THE 2026-08-21 FACT IS NOT CLOSED, DELIBERATELY. Its first half — that dynograph-foundation's design designates the seam published while its code has it pub(crate) — was true of that repo when read and nobody has re-checked it. Closing the whole record would assert something unmeasured about another project. `valid_to` claims the WHOLE thing stopped being true, and only the reflow2-facing half did.

⚠️ WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: how many other facts name a retired dependency as their subject. One instance, found by being misled by it. It is not known whether this is a class.
